message.content: {"issues":[{"number":11,"field":"context","problem":"The transcription does not preserve the source map’s identification/linkage of the three mapped regions with (가)–(다); it only gives generalized locations for three shaded areas. This removes information needed to connect the bars and map to the region names used in the choices."},{"number":11,"field":"context","problem":"The graph description supplies inferred approximate numerical values for every stacked segment and total, although the source provides a graphic with axis/gridlines rather than printed segment values. These derived values are not source text and could affect interpretation."},{"number":12,"field":"context","problem":"The source displays the occurrences of A–C and (가)–(다) in the stimulus as outlined boxed blanks. The transcription removes the boxes/blanks, including their repeated placements."},{"number":14,"field":"context","problem":"The transcription does not preserve the individual (가)–(라) route identifications/line-style-to-route correspondence shown by the map and its arrows. It describes four arrows generally but does not specify which displayed route is each labeled route."},{"number":15,"field":"context","problem":"The map description calls (나) a ‘둥근 산지’ and states a flow direction for the present stream. The source visibly shows contours, stream traces, and the dotted (나) area, but does not label (나) as a mountain or mark stream-flow direction; these are interpretive additions that can affect the geographic relationship being tested."}],"checked_numbers":[11,12,13,14,15]}
